Guidance & outlook: But c urrently where we are at about $ 11 billion, we're expecting over the next eight years this should move to approximately $28.5 billion at about 11% CAGR.

So what we are confident is that the number of projects that we can take up in this coming year will be much higher and next year, when we go to the next year, I think we will see the results of whatever, what all we are doing in this year.

I just wanted to mention this, you know, last, you know, meetings in the investor meeting or the earnings call, we mentioned that for the medium term we are talking about a 14 to 15 percentage guidance.
Growth & demand: This is a business in which we need to deliver consistently year-on-year, outpacing the industry growth and you automatically will land up making good returns in the future because the structural flow for the industry is so strong, where less than 6% of Indians have ever been diagnosed.
We have very clearly, distinctly 5 growth engines, for as far as the business growth is concerned, to deliver the sustainable and profitable business growth.

So on the channels per se, what I think both Am eera and Surendran specified on both B2C and B2B, while B2C is roughly 57% of the revenue share of the company, and that also is at a very good growth in the last quarter, it was around 18% growth.
Margins & costs: Our EBITDA has also Metropolis Healthcare Limited August 27, 2026 grown at about 18.6% CAGR for three years and last year was 23% a nd the same thing with PAT, very similar numbers.

We service around 2200-odd pincodes that are there, and the D2C, the digital piece around that, ensures that we have a lower acquisition cost of acquiring the customers as well as almost 2x of the LTV of a regular lifetime value of the regular customer coming through our offline channels.
So that has the way to go to 45% of the revenue and what we're focusing on, as Am eera also pointed out earlier, is largely margin -accretive accounts.
Capex & expansion: As we saw last year, our North India contribution was less than 10%, about 7 %-8%, and we've managed to move this up by 10% in a year's time because we did some interesting acquisitions last year and they're using that as a base to grow North India very quickly.
On the B2B side, what is also adding up and what is aiding the growth of B2B I mean, the last quarter was 15%-odd is the addition of Core test menu after the acquisition of Core Diagnostics.
Acquisition, of course, will more add on the 14 %-15% guidance that we provided doesn't include acquisitions.
Balance sheet & cash: We recently did the bonus issue of 3:1, sort of a split bonus that we did and we usually do a dividend.
We are looking forward to automate our receivables management, automate our supply chain with the vendors.
So, our aspiration is to take our working capital to a single digit from currently the double-digit working capital.
Risks & challenges: It's not about the production alone which is the challenge.

But if I was to look at this 20 years later, this is going to be a far more consolidated industry, an industry where we will continue to see the existing leaders thrive and grow and honestly, your ability to build success over the next 20 years is not linked to any disruption in the market.
We had CEO change, we had leadership chan ge, we had a bunch of external issues and challenges that hit us.

Guidance & outlook: We believe this is a good start to our year and that we can sustain revenue growth outlook of 14%-15% for the year, which we expect to be primarily driven by volume growth.

Supported by ongoing operational efficiencies and cost optimization initiatives, we expect an improvement of 100-150 basis points on EBITDA during the current financial year and over this year and the next year, we remain focused on achieving an EBITDA margin of 27%-28%.
